name: titan-installer
description: Electron installer + dashboard for the Titan Claude Code governance harness.

author.name: Titan harness maintainer (set via titan.config.json org.display_name)

scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -k -n "vite,electron" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev" "wait-on tcp:5173 && npm run dev:electron-only"
scripts.build: npm run sync:install && tsc && vite build && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json
scripts.package: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder
scripts.sync:install: node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('installer/titan-configure.py','assets/install.py')" && echo [sync] assets/install.py updated from installer/titan-configure.py
